fun show(names: [String]) = println("${names.len()} names")

fun main() {
    var names: [String] = ["ada"]
    show(names)               // lends it: show(&names)
    names.push("bob".to_string())
    val copy = names.clone()  // explicit copy
    val moved = names         // `names` is moved
    println("${copy:?} ${moved:?}")
}

shared class Player(var name: String, var score: i32 = 0)

fun main() {
    val p = Player("Ada")
    val team = vec[p]       // the list holds the same player
    team[0].score += 10
    println("${p.name}: ${p.score}")
}

fun main() {
    val answer = 42              // immutable (Rust `let`)
    var count = 0                // mutable (Rust `let mut`)
    count += 1

    val pi: f64 = 3.14159        // explicit type
    val big: Long = 10_000_000L  // Kotlin names work too: Int, Long, Double, Boolean, Char
    val flag = true
    val letter = 'x'
    val (q, r) = (17 / 5, 17 % 5)  // destructuring
    val few = count as usize < 3   // `as` converts between number types

    println("$answer $count $pi $big $flag $letter $q $r $few")
}

fun main() {
    val name = "Oxie"
    val version = 1.25
    println("$name ${version:.1}")       // format spec after `:` (Rust format syntax)
    println("next: ${version + 0.75}")
    println("debug: ${listOf(1, 2):?}")  // `:?` is Debug formatting

    val greeting = "Hello, " + name + "!"  // `+` with strings builds a String
    println(greeting)

    val poem = """
        Roses are red,
          $name is new.
        """                                // indentation is trimmed automatically
    println(poem)
    println("a dollar: \$5")
}

fun total(xs: &[i32]): i32 = xs.iter().sum()
fun add_one(xs: &mut [i32]) = xs.push(1)

fun main() {
    var v: [i32] = [1, 2, 3]
    add_one(v)            // the parameter is `&mut`, so `v` is lent mutably: add_one(&mut v)
    println(total(v))     // ... and here lent for reading: total(&v)
    val w = v.clone()     // explicit copy
    val moved = v         // `v` can't be used after this
    println("${w:?} ${moved:?}")
}

fun main() {
    val first: String = "Ada"
    val last: String = "Lovelace"
    val full = first + " " + last      // format!("{} {}", first, last)
    val joined = first + last          // format!("{}{}", first, last)
    var log: String = "start"
    log += last                        // log += &last
    println("$full, $joined, $log, $first $last")
}

fun main() {
    var stock: [String: i32] = [:]
    stock["pen"] = 3                          // stock.insert(String::from("pen"), 3)
    for (item in ["pen", "ink", "pen"]) *stock.entry(item.to_string()).or_default() += 1
    println("${stock["pen"]} ${stock["ink"]}")

    val shelves: [String: [String]] = ["new": ["Dune"], "old": []]
    var seen = [1, 2]
    seen.push(3)                              // a list: `vec![1, 2]`
    val words = "b a".split(' ').to_list()    // [T] of the iterator's items
    println("${shelves["new"]:?} ${seen:?} ${words:?}")
}
